title: Analysis code for "Assistive Technologies on Safety Monitoring for Community-Dwelling Persons Living with Dementia"
description:
Analysis code for the paper "Assistive Technologies on Safety Monitoring for Community-Dwelling Persons Living with Dementia", accepted for publication in Scientific Reports. It covers the participant characteristics (Table 1), the sleep and in-home sensor comparison (Table 2), the participant-level prediction models (Table 3), and Figures 1–3.

The original dataset cannot be shared because it contains personal information. A synthetic dataset with the same format is provided instead; its values are random draws and do not reproduce the published results.
